schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the report template contract.

name.description: Display name shown in the Report Builder catalog.

version.description: Semantic version of the template definition.

description.description: Long-form description rendered in selection dialogs and documentation.

tags.description: Optional classification tags used for filtering in the catalog.

sections.description: Ordered list of report sections rendered by the template.

csv.description: Optional CSV exports keyed by contributing section.

geoJson.description: Optional GeoJSON exports referencing section-provided features.

outputs.description: Export bundle configuration for the template.

templateId.description: Stable identifier for the report template (reverse-DNS style).

reportScope.description: Context scope that the template operates on.

sectionId.description: Identifier for a report section contributed by a plugin.

reportCapability.description: Named capability or dataset required for rendering a section.

title.description: Optional override title rendered above the section.

required.description: When false, the section is skipped if prerequisites are not met.

options.description: Plugin-defined options forwarded to the section renderer.

requiresCapabilities.description: Capabilities that must be available for the section to render.

requiresSections.description: Other sections that must successfully render before this section.

when.description: Conditional requirements controlling whether the section is included.

sectionPlacement.description: Placement and behavior overrides for a report section.

region.description: Report region where the section should render.

order.description: Relative ordering hint within the region.

column.description: Zero-based column index in multi-column layouts.

columnSpan.description: Number of columns occupied by the section.

rowSpan.description: Number of row units consumed by the section.

sectionLayout.description: Layout hint used by the PDF renderer when assembling the template.

pageSize.description: Output page size for the generated PDF.

orientation.description: Page orientation for the exported PDF.

includeTableOfContents.description: When true, adds an automatically generated table of contents.

theme.description: Theme identifier controlling typography and color palette.

pdfOutput.description: PDF export configuration for the template.

filename.description: Filename to assign to the CSV artifact in the export bundle.

columns.description: Optional list of column identifiers to request from the section.

csvExport.description: Configuration for generating a CSV export from a section.

filename.description: Filename assigned to the GeoJSON artifact.

featureRole.description: Semantic role of the exported features (e.g., crop.layers, risk.hotspots).

geoJsonExport.description: Configuration for exporting GeoJSON features contributed by a section.
